summary: Iteration 4 (CSV export + Appointment notes) fully verified. 31/31 pytest tests pass (11 new in test_meridian_csv_notes.py + full regression of test_meridian_api.py + test_meridian_admin.py). Frontend UI: admin login, CSV export bar with date pickers + Download (network 200 text/csv confirmed), per-card Private notes editor (Unsaved changes -> Save -> ✓ Saved toast -> disabled), notes persist across reload, confirm/cancel status buttons still work with the new PATCH schema, public booking end-to-end (POST returned 201, apt visible in admin with empty notes). Mobile 390x844 renders with no horizontal overflow (export bar and card head stack vertically). Verified stat digit spans use `font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums` — screenshots show clean 1/0/12/13 etc. Grace Reyes demo appointment preserved with original status=requested and notes='Bring sleep-tracking data. Discuss Rx options.'; all TEST_ data + booking_attempts + login_attempts cleaned.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/admin/appointments.csv uses lexicographic upper bound `date_to + 'T99'` which works because 'T99' > any valid 'T23:59:59' ISO substring. Slightly hacky but correct for ISO strings; consider using date_to + 'T23:59:59.999999+99:99' or a real datetime comparator for readability. Not a bug.
server.py: PATCH admin_update_status returns Appointment(**result) after setdefault('notes',''). Good — handles legacy docs.
server.py: StatusIn.notes is bounded to max_length=4000 which is good. Consider also stripping/limiting name/message consistently.
Admin.tsx: exportCsv triggers real download; on error branch there's no user-facing toast — silently swallowed by the try/finally. Consider surfacing 'Export failed' via a small inline notice.

Admin.tsx: NoteEditor save() throws on failure, which becomes a rejected promise in saveNotes -> propagates to NoteEditor's own catch that sets status='error'. Chain works; small nit — the optimistic state in saveNotes is rolled back but the local NoteEditor `value` stays the newly-typed value. On reload the server value wins, so no persistent drift.

CORS still allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — carried over from iteration 3, browsers ignore cookies with wildcard origin. Same-origin deployment works today; future cross-origin will need explicit origin list.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Three backend test files now exist under /app/backend/tests/: test_meridian_api.py (public appointments/availability), test_meridian_admin.py (auth + admin + spam shield), test_meridian_csv_notes.py (CSV export + notes PATCH). Run all with: `set -a; source /app/frontend/.env; source /app/backend/.env; set +a; cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v`. All files self-clean their TEST_-prefixed data. The CSV date filter uses a lexicographic upper bound `date_to + 'T99'` which is inclusive of the entire `date_to` day; be aware if querying with same from==to date.
